title: Role-aware connected-account surfaces for invited members
gap: The connected-account routes require the owner (requireOwner). A member opening Cast sees 'Connect it once…' and an 'Open Workspace › Engines' button they cannot use (CastStage.tsx:252,267-268). Gen shows members the 'Higgsfield catalogue' tab and then blocks it (use-composer.ts:383). Business, Viral and Gen each fetch /api/me separately (use-business.ts:28, use-viral.ts:44, use-composer.ts:217).
target: One useConnectedCapability() hook in lib/shell, cached per scope, returning {owner, connected, reconnect, ownerName}. Members see a single calm card, 'Higgsfield-account tools are run by <owner>', with the workspace-credit alternative (Gen Studio engines; Cast reference stills on Studio image engines). Connected-only tabs are hidden for members, and the Business and Viral suite tabs carry an 'Owner' badge.
respects_rules: Members never spend through the owner's account. No higgsfield.ai library content is shown.
